position_overview: STAFF ACCOUNTING SUPPORT SPECIALIST POSITION SUMMARY The Staff Accounting Support Specialist combines senior-level accounting execution with Tier 1 technical and application support. This role focuses on core accounting operations, monthly close, reconciliations, and GAAP compliance while also supporting accounting systems, ERP tools, and user-reported issues. The position partners closely with Accounting, Finance, and Support teams and serves as a functional accounting expert with strong system and data proficiency. RESPONSIBILITIES Prepare and review monthly, quarter-end, and year-end journal entries. Own balance sheet account reconciliations and resolve reconciling items on a timely basis. Analyze balance sheet and P&L variances and provide clear explanations and corrective actions. Support monthly close activities and ensure adherence to close calendars and accuracy standards. Prepare accruals and analyze large datasets to support corporate accounting processes. Support intercompany transactions, reconciliations, and eliminations. Assist with data preparation and uploads into consolidation and reporting systems. Support internal and external audits and prepare required financial schedules. Ensure compliance with US GAAP, internal policies, and SOX-related controls. Identify and document process improvements and support internal control enhancements. Provide Tier 1 functional and technical support for accounting systems and applications. Troubleshoot user-reported accounting and system issues and document resolutions in CRM tools. Partner with cross-functional teams to resolve data, system, and process-related issues. Support ad hoc analysis and special projects as assigned. Support flexible work hours during close cycles and peak periods. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance is required. Master's degree is preferred. Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting experience. Public accounting experience is preferred. Experience in a global or multi-entity environment is strongly preferred. Experience in software or SaaS companies is preferred. CPA or equivalent certification is preferred but not required. Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and general accounting principles.
